blocks.text: Nitrogen hawa ka aham juz hai, jo apne chhote size, mutawazan (symmetrical) electron cloud aur non-polar triple bond ki wajah se kam reactivity ke liye jani jati hai. Configuration 1s2 2s2 2p3 ke saath nitrogen ko apna octet mukammal karne ke liye teen electrons chahiye, to woh doosre nitrogen atom ke saath teen electrons baant kar triple bond banati hai (Figure 12.1). Is bond ki bond enthalpy +944 kJ mol-1 hai, aur naye bonds banne se pehle ise torne ke liye darkar zyada energy N2 ko bohat ghair-reactive banati hai. Doosri wajah bond ki non-polarity hai: dono atoms ek jaise hain, electronegativity ka farq sifar, to teenon bonded pairs barabar baante jate hain.

blocks.alt: Do bare daire ek doosre par chadhe hue, har ek ke andar N ke gird chhota daira. Baen chhote daire par neele nuqton ka jora aur daen par surkh jora. Bilkul baen kinare par neela jora aur daen kinare par surkh jora. Jahan dono bare daire milte hain wahan chhe nuqte, bari bari neele aur surkh, ek qatar mein. Daen taraf N≡N likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.1: N2 molecule mein bonding (kitab ki Figure 12.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neele nuqte baen N ke electrons hain aur surkh nuqte daen N ke. Dono daire jahan milte hain wahan teen jore (chhe electrons) baante (shared) gaye hain: yahi teen bonds, yani N≡N triple bond hai. Har N ke bahar wale kinare par ek akela jora (lone pair) hai, aur chhote daire par andar wale khol (inner shell) ke do electrons. Is tarah har N ke bahar wale khol mein aath electrons poore ho jate hain.

blocks.prompt: N2 ki inertness ki do wajuhat batayein, aur wazeh karein ke CO, jis mein triple bond bhi hai, zyada reactive kyun hai (exercise Q.2a; Quick Check 12.1b).
blocks.explanation: N-N triple bond bohat mazboot (+944 kJ mol-1) aur bilkul non-polar hai, to na aasani se toot-ta hai na us par hamla hota hai. CO mein bond do mukhtalif atoms ko jorta hai, to woh polar hai, carbon wala sira lone pair rakhta hai jo diya ja sakta hai, aur molecule aisi reactive jagah deta hai jo N2 ke paas nahi.

items: N2 apne mazboot triple bond (+944 kJ mol-1), non-polarity (ek jaise atoms) aur chhote, mutawazan electron cloud ki wajah se inert hai; nitrogen hawa mein oxygen ko halka karti aur oils aur reactions par parda dalti hai.
